question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "located."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes a situation where most of the largest cities in the world are situated on or close to rivers, lakes, or oceans
 
• "Located" means to find the exact position of somebody/something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के सही ठिकाने का पता लगाना)
 
 
• Example:* The damaged ship has been **located**__ two kilometres off the coast.​*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3."
 
• Correct passage:

A flood occurs when water overflows its natural __barriers__ and lands on typically dry ground. Floods have always been an __unavoidable__ component of life on the planet. A legend about a __huge__ flood exists in almost every civilisation. Many people have __chosen__ to live near bodies of water in order to have access to transportation routes, fishing, and water for drinking, farming, and industry. The majority of the world's major cities are __**located**__ on or near oceans, lakes, or rivers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

 
• Looking at other options:

 
 
• **Endangered: **to cause danger to somebody/something. ((व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को) ख़तरे में डालना)
 
• **Confiscated: **to take something away from somebody as a punishment. (दंडस्‍वरूप कोई वस्‍तु ज़ब्‍त कर लेना)
 
• **Banned: **to officially say that something is not allowed, often by law. (प्रायः क़ानूनी तौर पर प्रतिबंध या रोक लगाना; आधिकारिक)
